title: Real-time PCR Detection of Bordetella pertussis and Related Species
author: Adria D. Lee
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kvxcw7n

steps.title: Prepare IS 481, pIS 1001, and hIS 1001 Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare 10X stock solutions and working concentrations for the specified primers and probes using sterile PCR grade water.

substeps.instruction: For IS 481: Prepare 30 μM primers and 90 μM probe (10X). Aliquot into 10-reaction volumes and store at -20ºC. Dilute 1:10 to 3 μM primers and 9 μM probe just before use.
For pIS 1001: Prepare 90 μM primers and 30 μM probe (10X). Aliquot into 10-reaction volumes and store at -20ºC. Dilute 1:10 to 9 μM primers and 3 μM probe just before use.
For hIS 1001: Prepare 30 μM primers and 30 μM probe (10X). Aliquot into 10-reaction volumes and store at -20ºC. Dilute 1:10 to 3 μM primers and 3 μM probe just before use.
Cover probe aliquot tubes with foil or use dark colored tubes; store for up to 6 months at -20ºC.

steps.title: Prepare ptxS1 Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare 10X stock solutions and working concentrations for ptxS1 primers and probe using sterile PCR grade water.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 70 μM primers and 30 μM probe (10X).
Dispense 10X working concentrations into 10-reaction aliquots and store at -20ºC. Cover probe tubes with foil or use dark colored tubes.
Avoid storage in frost-free freezers and do not re-freeze thawed aliquots.
Dilute 10X solution 1:10 to prepare 7 μM working concentrations of primers and 3 μM working concentration of probe just before running the assay.

steps.title: Prepare RNaseP Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare working concentrations for RNaseP primers and probe using sterile PCR grade water.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 4 μM working concentrations of primers and 1 μM working concentration of probe.
Dispense into 10-reaction aliquots and store in dark for up to 6 months at -20ºC.

steps.title: Prepare Master Mix for IS 481, pIS 1001, and hIS 1001
steps.instruction: Assemble the PCR mix in a 1.5 ml tube.

substeps.instruction: Thaw working concentrations of primers and probe and mix gently by pipetting.
Add 0.84 μl per reaction of each working concentration of each primer and probe to the tube.
Add 1 μl of PCR-grade water per reaction.
Mix PerfeCTa ® qPCR ToughMix, UNG by pipetting up and down, then add 12.5 μl of the 2X master mix per reaction.
Mix by pipetting and quick spin.

steps.title: Load Plate for IS 481, pIS 1001, and hIS 1001
steps.instruction: Dispense the master mix and add samples/controls to the 96-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 23 μl of master mix to each test well.
For NTC well: Add 4 μl of water and 21 μl of master mix.
For sample wells: Add 4 μl of sample DNA. Test all specimens in duplicate, and perform a third reaction with a 1:5 dilution of the DNA extract.
For positive control wells: Add 4 μl of positive control dilutions.
Close wells with optical caps.

steps.title: Run IS 481, pIS 1001, and hIS 1001 Assay
steps.instruction: Finalize plate preparation and execute the PCR run.

substeps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the 96-well plate and confirm reaction mixes are at the bottom with no bubbles.
Place the plate in the AB7500, close the tray, and start the run.
